csv_agency: New York City Department of Parks & Recreation
csv_scope_of_work: Request for Expressions of Interest and Information (RFEI) for Identification, Inventorying, and Assessment of Parks Assets for Capital Planning.NYC Parks seeks to better understand the complete inventory of assets on Parklands, to have them fully mapped on GIS along with relevant asset data and regularly inspected to identify their current state of repair and potential level of Capital need. To achieve this goal the agency launched its Capital Needs Assessment (CNA) program in 2016, implementing a citywide parks needs assessment strategy to identify and target capital investments where the needs are greatest. The essential elements of Parks capital needs assessment approach include: Definition of an asset hierarchy defining the relationship between assets, their systems and components Development of a standardized protocol for asset inspections Creation of data collection and analysis tools to support asset condition assessment, reporting, and prioritization.
